note: Adapted from the original description in Holmgren 1913c (Termitenstudien 4), p. 181 (alate, soldier) and p. 182 (worker), original in German; all three castes are described, and the key entries are on p. 158 and p. 163. German decimal commas are changed here to points, the values and ranges unchanged. The OCR text has many row shifts on these pages: alate head width 1,37 read as 0,87 (confused with the soldier measurements on the preceding line), pronotum width 1,06 read as 0s, and pronotum length 0,68 read as 0,(>&8; all were entered after checking character by character against the archive.org BookReader images of printed pages 181 and 182 (leaves 180 and 181). The species was then placed in Eutermes.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate body length with wings 15 mm, head width 1.37 mm, pronotum width 1.06 mm; soldier body length 3 mm, head length including nasus 1.44 mm, head width 0.87 mm; the worker occurs in two size classes, body length 3.5—4 mm and 3 mm respectively. In the alate the ocelli are very small, more than twice their own diameter from the compound eyes, and the antennae are 15-segmented with segments 2, 3 and 4 about equal; the soldier head is black, the nasus medium-sized and conical, and the frontal outline has a distinct elevation behind the base of the nasus.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule very dark chestnut-brown, the clypeal sclerite rusty yellow; pronotum concolorous with the head, with an indistinct T-shaped mark; meso- and metanota pale rusty yellow to rusty brown, paler anteriorly than posteriorly; abdominal tergites brown, sternites paler; tibiae slightly brownish; the rest rusty yellow; wings greyish brown with a weak subcostal stripe. Head densely hairy, abdominal tergites densely hairy, only the outer half of the wing with short sparse hairs. Head broadly oval, narrowing anteriorly; compound eyes small, slightly prominent; ocelli very small, more than twice their own diameter from the compound eyes; fontanelle small, more or less triangular or slit-like; clypeal sclerite very short, flatly arched, anterior margin incurved; antennae 15-segmented, segments 2, 3 and 4 about equal, segment 5 slightly shorter than segment 4. Pronotum longer than half its width, trapezoidal, posterior margin weakly concave; mesonotum broad but not deeply concave; metanotum narrower, less deeply concave, posterior corners rounded. Media simple or with only one pair of apical branches, with several additional short anterior branches in the subcostal region. Measurements: body length with wings 15 mm; body length without wings 7 mm; fore wing 10 mm; head length 1.44 mm; head width 1.37 mm; pronotum width 1.06 mm; pronotum length 0.68 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head black to brown, nasus sometimes paler; body pale brown above, antennae slightly brownish, the rest milky yellow; postmentum brown. Head with only a few bristles, abdominal tergites very finely hairy and with long marginal bristles. Head broadly oval, narrowing anteriorly; nasus medium-sized, conical; frontal outline with a distinct elevation behind the base of the nasus; antennae rather long, 13-segmented, segment 3 far longer than segment 2, segment 4 equal to segment 2. Pronotum weakly saddle-shaped, anterior margin not concave. Measurements: body length 3 mm; head including nasus 1.44 mm; head without nasus 0.72 mm; head width 0.87 mm; pronotum width 0.42 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Two forms. Major: head plate brown, the transverse band paler (often brown only at the posterior sides); body pale brown above, the rest milky yellow; head rather sparsely hairy, abdominal tergites more densely hairy. Head pentagonal, head sutures and fontanelle very distinct, frons depressed; clypeal sclerite rather short, strongly arched; mandibular condyle large; antennae short, 14-segmented, segments 3 and 4 short and shorter than segment 2, or segment 3 equal to segment 2 and segment 4 shorter. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin mostly slightly concave. Minor: paler, body milky yellow, antennae 13—14-segmented. Measurements: major body length 3.5—4 mm, head width 1.14 mm, pronotum width 0.57 mm; minor body length 3 mm, head width 0.84 mm, pronotum width 0.38 mm. Distribution: Menado, Celebes (Cambridge Museum).
